outcome: Disruption of circular (inner myometrium) smooth muscle
Severity of pathology related to Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS)
cohort: The participants were peripartum and non-pregnant CD-1 mice and Il10-/- mice subjected to uterine surgery or sham operations.
finding: Surgical uterine scarring in mice, regardless of surgical method, led to deeper trophoblast invasion and significant disruption of the myometrium relative to controls, with Il10-/- mice showing more severe pathology.
mod_finding: Uterine scarring created by hysterotomy, simulating a cesarean section, resulted in deeper trophoblast invasion and myometrial disruption, modeling aspects of Placenta Accreta Spectrum.
